title: Tommy Garner Air Conditioning Heating
description: tommygarner.com zoominfo.com/c/tommy-garner-air-conditioning--heating/140230813 Tommy Garner Air Conditioning & Heating (Tommy Garner, Inc., founded 1986 by Tommy and Chrissy Garner in Newport News, Virginia) is a family-owned Class A HVAC contractor serving the Hampton Roads region for 40 years. It provides commercial and residential air conditioning, heating, generators (authorized Honeywell dealer), water heaters, commercial refrigeration and indoor air-quality solutions — with 24-hour emergency service, 30-day service guarantees and 1-year installation warranties. Led today by founder Tommy Garner alongside his son Zach and daughter Lauren Jett, the company employs 35–39 people and was named Virginia Peninsula Chamber Small Business of the Year 2024 and a 2025 Best Places to Work in Virginia (the only HVAC firm on the list). Its reputation is exceptional — an A BBB rating and 5-star reviews from clients including the Virginia Living Museum
